backlog.reason: Names can cross periods or be modern reconstruction labels; require object, region, time, construction and multiple-view geometry.
Useful geometric presets can be authored without pretending each represents all women in an era.
Do not infer ethnicity, marital status or ritual entitlement from hairstyle; separate ornaments from hair.
Map to measured geometry first; add dated regional primary source before current-trend badge.
